title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje ne Rezidencen Kodra e Diellit 2 ne Tirane (ID 4121745)
description_sq:
Ne Rezidencen Kodra e Diellit 2, shitet apartament 2+1, siperfaqa 126 m², kati 2 banim ne nje pallat te ri shume cilesor. Apartamenti organizohet nje dhome ndenje, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, ballkon. Apartamenti eshte i gjithi i investuar dhe mobiluar ne menyre moderne, me parket, kondicionere, elktroshtepiake dhe hidrosanitare shume cilesore te markave me te mira. I ndodhur ne nje nga rezidencat me te mira ne mes te gjelberimit, ajrit te paster, dhe pamjes fantastike te qytetit te Tiranes, apartamenti eshte nje mundesi e mire per nje jetese komode larg pluhurit dhe zhurmes se qytetit. Gjithashtu eshte nje mundesi shume e mire per investim pasi eshte nje zone shume e kerkuar me qera nga rezidente te huaj.
Cmimi 315000 Euro
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Residence Kodra e Diellit 2 in Tirana (ID 4121745)
description_en: In Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, 2+1 apartment for sale, surface area 126 m², 2nd floor in a new high-quality building. The apartment has a living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, balcony. The apartment is all invested and furnished in a modern way, with parquet, air conditioners, high-quality electrical and plumbing fixtures of the best brands. Located in one of the best residences in the middle of greenery, clean air, and a fantastic view of the city of Tirana, the apartment is a good opportunity for a comfortable life away from the dust and noise of the city. It is also a very good opportunity for investment as it is a very sought-after area for rent by foreign residents. Price 315000 Euro
